_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Maintainability and Built In Test Demonstration Procedure
summary: Provides detailed technical directions for implementing a maintainability or Built In Test (BIT) demonstration, used by the procuring activity to review and approve the contractor's procedure for conducting the demonstration.
use_relationship:
The Maintainability and Built In Test (BIT) Demonstration Procedure provides detailed technical directions for implementing a maintainability or BIT demonstration at the equipment, subsystem, or system levels during the integrated test program. The procedure contains step-by-step instructions for how the equipment, including software, involved is utilized during the test or demonstration. This document is used by the procuring activity for review and approval of the contractor's procedure for conducting the maintainability or BIT demonstration.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-81604A
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Maintainability and BIT Demonstration Procedure shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Maintainability and BIT Demonstration Procedure shall contain:

children.title: Test objectives and quantitative goals or requirements to be demonstrated
children.content: including specific references to the applicable sections of the specification.

children.title: Description of the test team roles and responsibilities
A list and brief description of all units
children.content: comprising the equipment and a specific listing of those units that are placed on test and the up-to-date configuration (drawing list, including approved changes, waivers, and deviations), including software configuration.

children.title: A list and description of all test and
children.content: monitoring equipment and software, including: manufacturer, model number, calibration records (where applicable), software configuration information, and facility descriptions and requirements.

children.title: Allowable adjustments and normal checkout procedures
children.content: for the equipment under test.

children.title: A description of all preventive maintenance measures
children.content: to be performed during the test, if such maintenance is permitted by the detailed equipment specification.

children.title: Interconnecting cable diagrams and interface conditions
children.content: of complete test, setup including equipment under test and test monitoring equipment.

children.title: Performance parameters to be measured
children.content: frequency of measurement, and the method used.

children.title: A description of test methods and mode(s)
children.content: of operation of the items under test, including configuration and mission requirements.

children.title: Procedure for selection of maintenance tasks
children.content: when faults are simulated.

children.title: Identification of special maintenance tasks
The statistical maintainability or BIT design criteria
children.content: as appropriate, including decision criteria (fail and accept criteria), if applicable.

children.title: Test duration and conditions
children.content: including the duty cycle and environmental, operational, and performance profiles during performance parameter measurement.

children.title: A list of data elements
children.content: to be recorded during tests and acquisition methods.

children.title: Include preliminary applicable data collection sheets
children.content: and scoring and evaluation criteria (i.e., Failure Definition and Scoring Criteria), including: the data analysis methods, analytical procedures, and evaluation methodology that are used to compute maintainability or BIT performance based on the data collected during testing.

children.title: A list of the maintenance tasks
children.content: to be verified, demonstrated, and evaluated.

children.title: Description of anticipated system faults
children.content: and mapping of fault detection by BIT.

children.title: Description of BIT fault insertion technique(s)
children.content: including how and where faults are inserted.

children.title: A description of maintenance concept and level(s)
children.content: of maintenance.

children.title: Description of and assessment of the adequacy
children.content: of the item support elements, and an estimate of their effect on the item maintainability to include:

children.title: Maintenance planning
Support equipment, tools, and test equipment
Supply support, including both spares and consumables
Transportation, handling, and storage
Technical data, including technical manuals to be used
Any applicable safety and calibration equipment
The Government furnished property requirements
children.content: and identification of the impact of use of Government furnished property.

children.title: Identification of the failure Reporting, Analysis
children.content: and Corrective Action (FRACAS) system to be used.

children.title: Detailed reason for each proposed deviation
The test conduct ground rules
children.content: and identification of the system interface boundaries.

children.title: A description of the action(s) to be taken
children.content: if a reject decision is reached, including corrective action plan and retest provisions.
